title: Fresh Invoice Status
description: A newly cut invoice hasn't been paid yet — the ledger should say so plainly the moment it's created, before any payment attempt has even happened.
successCondition: Book a shipment, then POST /api/billing/shipments/:shipmentId/invoice with no payment attempted yet. The 201 response's invoice.status is "open". Querying the invoices table via `npm run db:psql` for that row confirms status = 'open' and that no row exists yet in payments for that invoice_id (select count(*) from payments where invoice_id = '<id>' returns 0).
hints: InvoiceStatus defaults to "open" at the Prisma schema level (prisma/schema.prisma) — nothing sets it to "paid" until a successful payment does.
You'll need to book a shipment first via POST /api/booking to have a shipmentId to invoice.
